methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: VSU receives $1 million for new AI and cybersecurity center
signals.signal_reading: A $1M+ investment in VSU's AI center builds institutional capacity at an HBCU in metro Richmond, but the concentration of resources in established universities risks deepening the divide between regions with research institutions and those without.

signals.title: TurbineOne Establishes Virginia Headquarters, Launches T1 Edgeworks Innovation Center - The AI Journal
signals.signal_reading: TurbineOne establishing an innovation center headquarters in NoVA reinforces the region's gravitational pull for AI infrastructure and talent, concentrating deep technical capability in the state's already-dominant tech corridor.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI creating pressure on Richmond's young workforce without evidence of deep capability-building suggests shallow disruption without the distributed training infrastructure needed to move toward 'Build It Yourself' outcomes.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia represents exactly the distributed, peer-network approach needed to spread AI fluency beyond metros, though sustainability beyond grant funding remains uncertain.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: RC-RV partnering with ed2go for on-demand training platforms signals broad but potentially shallow AI adoption—accessible across regions but relying on pre-packaged tools rather than building deep local technical capacity.
